/verified by @damdo

### Verification

Verified by comparing the [failing job without the fix](https://prow.ci.openshift.org/view/gs/test-platform-results/pr-logs/pull/openshift_release/79750/rehearse-79750-pull-ci-openshift-cluster-api-provider-metal3-main-e2e-metal3-capi-techpreview-post-install/2059639064553852928) against the [passing job with the fix](https://prow.ci.openshift.org/view/gs/test-platform-results/pr-logs/pull/openshift_cluster-api-provider-metal3/82/pull-ci-openshift-cluster-api-provider-metal3-main-e2e-metal3-capi-techpreview-post-install/2059951847455592448).

#### Without the fix: FAILED

The capi-operator hits a terminal collision error on the `metal3remediations` and `metal3remediationtemplates` CRDs (installed by CVO) and retries every ~10 minutes, never progressing past the `cluster-api-provider-metal3-crds` phase:

```
E0527 16:35:50 "Reconciler error" err="terminal error: collision with existing objects:
  apiextensions.k8s.io/v1, Kind=CustomResourceDefinition /metal3remediations.infrastructure.cluster.x-k8s.io,
  apiextensions.k8s.io/v1, Kind=CustomResourceDefinition /metal3remediationtemplates.infrastructure.cluster.x-k8s.io"
```

The `capm3-controller-manager` Deployment and `capm3-webhook-service` are never created. The baremetal MachineSet e2e test times out after 30 minutes:

```
[FAILED] Timed out after 1800.001s.
"baremetal-machineset": machine baremetal-machineset-j7tx6 in phase "Pending", want Running
```

The CRD on cluster (`oc get crd metal3remediations.infrastructure.cluster.x-k8s.io -o yaml`) remains as CVO installed it, no boxcutter labels, conversion strategy `None`:

```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    exclude.release.openshift.io/internal-openshift-hosted: "true"
    include.release.openshift.io/self-managed-high-availability: "true"
    include.release.openshift.io/single-node-developer: "true"
    release.openshift.io/feature-gate: -ClusterAPIMachineManagement,-ClusterAPIMachineManagementBaremetal
  # ^^^ CVO annotations only, no boxcutter labels or annotations
  # boxcutter refused to adopt this CRD due to collision protection
spec:
  conversion:
    strategy: None  # <-- no conversion webhook, capm3-webhook-service is unreachable
```

#### With the fix: PASSED

Zero collision errors in the capi-operator logs. Boxcutter successfully adopts the CRDs, adds its management labels, and updates the conversion strategy from `None` to `Webhook` pointing at `capm3-webhook-service`.

The CRD on cluster (`oc get crd metal3remediations.infrastructure.cluster.x-k8s.io -o yaml`) now shows boxcutter ownership and a working conversion webhook:

```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    capi-operator.openshift.io/revision: "1"  # <-- boxcutter revision tracking
    controller-gen.kubebuilder.io/version: v0.18.0
    service.beta.openshift.io/inject-cabundle: "true"
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: boxcutter  # <-- boxcutter adopted the CRD
    capi-operator.openshift.io/managed-by: cluster-api-provider-metal3
    cluster.x-k8s.io/provider: infrastructure-metal3
    cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1: v1beta1
spec:
  conversion:
    strategy: Webhook  # <-- conversion webhook now active
    webhook:
      clientConfig:
        service:
          name: capm3-webhook-service  # <-- pointing at the running service
          namespace: openshift-cluster-api
          path: /convert
```

The `capm3-controller-manager` deploys immediately, and all e2e tests pass (5 passed, 41 skipped, 0 failed).

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/cluster-api-provider-metal3/pull/82):

>## Summary
>
>- On Default clusters (`ClusterAPIMachineManagementBareMetal` feature gate off), CVO deploys the Metal3 Remediation CRDs via `openshift/manifests/`.
>- When the `ClusterAPIMachineManagementBareMetal` feature gate is enabled, the cluster-capi-operator becomes responsible for managing them instead.
>- Without the `adopt-existing` annotation, boxcutter's collision protection blocks the entire CAPM3 deployment (including the `capm3-controller-manager` Deployment and `capm3-webhook-service` Service) until the collisions are resolved, leaving the CRDs with conversion webhook config pointing at a non-existent service.
>- This adds `capi-operator.openshift.io/adopt-existing: always` to the `metal3remediations` and `metal3remediationtemplates` CRDs, following the same pattern as https://github.com/openshift/cluster-api/pull/274 for IPAM CRDs.
>
>Uses support added in https://github.com/openshift/cluster-capi-operator/pull/514
>
>## Test plan
>
>- [x] Deploy on a bare metal cluster with `ClusterAPIMachineManagementBareMetal` enabled
>- [x] Verify `capm3-controller-manager` deployment is created without collision delays
>- [ ] Verify the conversion webhook service is available immediately
>- [ ] Verify namespace deletion works (no stuck `Terminating` state due to missing webhook)
